milestone: Milestone 2 — Market Regime + Adaptive Strategy Intelligence

merged_implementation.characterization: ADVISORY — regime/strategy intelligence wired as a detached loop that emits recommendations + decision evidence but routes nothing to execution.

dod_verification.evidence: 4 independent str-Enums (direction/trend/volatility/liquidity); hysteresis applied to DIRECTION only via _apply_hysteresis with min_persistence_updates=2; staleness via max_age_ns. Tested.

Merged impl uses a 3-state EligibilityState{DISABLED,RESEARCH,EXECUTION}. Directive §4 requires richer maturity (research/shadow/replay/mock/paper/live) with isolated mock authorization. ADDRESSED in this package via cengine/strategy_maturity.py.
cengine/strategy_arbitration.py StrategyArbitrator.arbitrate resolves stale/duplicate/conflict/opposing/capital; returns selected/rejected/research. Tested.
EconomicRanker: net = gross - cost (once); deterministic research fallback explicitly labeled; unknown net stays None. Tested.

cengine/decision_events.py DecisionEventType already defines ORDER_INTENT/BROKER_ACK/PARTIAL_FILL/COMPLETE_FILL/EXIT_DECISION/REALIZED_OUTCOME/RISK_APPROVAL/RISK_REJECTION; only regime/recommendation/arbitration emitters existed. Execution-lifecycle emitters ADDED in this package.

trade.py:968-984 constructs RegimeStrategyPipeline; detached task _run_regime_intelligence (1007-1061) emits evidence+telemetry and returns out; out is NEVER handed to self.router. Confirmed non-routing.

See reports/native_strategy_architecture.json — heavy numerics (features/breadth/screening/ranking/risk) native/Metal; regime/strategy layer is lightweight orchestration (~34us/symbol, 201ms full-universe, off hot path). No migration warranted.

No native/Metal source changed by M2; existing order path (strategies.py -> CandidateRouter -> OrderManager -> native RiskEngine -> AlpacaExecutionVenue) and independent protective exit untouched. 489 tests green.

gaps_identified.detail: Advisory recommendations never reach CandidateRouter/OrderManager. Directive §3 requires the architecture be CAPABLE of generating eligible recommendations that reach the existing execution authority.
gaps_identified.resolution: cengine/strategy_execution_bridge.py routes eligible recommendations through the EXISTING router -> exposure gate -> native RiskEngine -> OrderManager.

gaps_identified.gap: No richer maturity / isolated mock authorization
gaps_identified.detail: Directive §4 wants research/shadow/replay/mock/paper/live with mock exercised under isolated test authorization without granting live eligibility.
gaps_identified.resolution: cengine/strategy_maturity.py MaturityState + ExecutionAuthorization; mock authorization is strictly separate from the advisory EXECUTION eligibility (live).

gaps_identified.detail: Only test doubles existed; §9 requires an isolated mock broker to exercise the full path.

gaps_identified.resolution: Execution emitters added; integrity tests added; financial events remain recoverable from the authoritative journal.

safety_invariants_confirmed.mandatory_protective_exit_independent: protective_exit.py ProtectiveExitCoordinator runs as its own 5s task on threshold -0.005, uses in-engine positions + live price source, submits via the SAME OrderManager; never arbitrated, never vetoed by strategy intelligence.
safety_invariants_confirmed.advisory_default_non_routing: All families default RESEARCH; arbitration 'selected' requires EXECUTION; pipeline has no order imports; bridge authorization defaults NONE.

conclusion: Merged M2 is IMPLEMENTATION-COMPLETE and OPERATIONALLY-ADVISORY. The remaining gaps are execution integration, richer maturity/mock authorization, an isolated mock broker, and execution-evidence emitters — all addressed in feature/m2-execution-certification without re-implementing merged components.
